scientific_limitations: The result applies to the canonical discretized two-point graph configuration model and its A5/S5 geometric quotients, not to continuous configuration quotient spaces without an equivariant comparison. Full literature priority is provisional.
title: Collapsible alternating and full-symmetry quotients of Petersen two-point configurations
